_comment: Per-ISO-country source priority for resolving a company: best/freshest FIRST.
The FOUNDATION (the source that supplies registry_id and anchors the identity)
is the highest-ranked source in this list that actually carries a registry
number. Wikidata never qualifies (it has no official registry_id), so it stays
FILL-ONLY no matter where it appears. National registers are most authoritative
and freshest -> top; GLEIF is a periodically-synced LEI aggregator (its
entity.registeredAs gives the national number) -> middle; Wikidata is
crowd-sourced and can be stale -> bottom. Countries not listed here fall back to
the auto-derived order [<national providers>, gleif, wikidata]. Edit freely:
reorder a country's array to change which source wins a field on agreement, and
which is tried first for the registry_id foundation.
Conflict rule lives in code: when two ranked sources disagree on a field the
field is left blank, UNLESS both records carry a data timestamp (last_update),
in which case the newer wins.
